The '''''Star Seeder''-class Colony Ship''' was a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]-capable [[Colony ship/Legends|colony transport]] made by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Deepx-starseeder-tur.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A ''Star Seeder''-class colonization ship with a [[Deep-X Explorer]]]]
The ''Star Seeder'' was 250 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long and had a capacity of 3,000 [[Cubic meter/Legends|cubic meters]], within which could be stored 7,500 [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]] of cargo.<ref name="GG8" /> It was crewed by 169 people<ref name="TUR" /> and had room for up to 800 passengers. For defense, the class was armed with 6 [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] batteries, a [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] projector and a [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]].<ref name="GG8" />

The cargo area was divided into many different compartments, allowing colonists to transport different materials, tools, plants and wildlife in separate sections. The ship's hangar had enough space for a small shuttle, some speeders and other ground equipment, which could be brought down on a planet by the vessel itself.<ref name="GG8" />
